In this position, you will be assigned to one or more of ispace's projects, and join a small, international team of engineers working towards the detailed design and qualification of our first missions. Candidates with demonstrated "hands-on" experience in some engineering domains and interdisciplinary experience are preferred. Teamwork is valued, and depending on the strengths of each member of the systems engineering team, the responsibilities listed below will be assigned accordingly. Lead and perform safety analyses including Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA/FMECA), and related methods. Perform system level trade-offs, coordinating inputs from various disciplines within the team, to evaluate any proposed changes of the design baseline to satisfy the need of each individual mission. Ensure internal interfaces between various spacecraft subsystems are maintained. Contribute to requirements management ensuring all requirements are closed-out at the planned project landmarks. Support AIT/Flight&Test Operations Groups and subsystem leads in defining test plans and specifications which will successfully verify the spacecraft design. Coordinate efforts between relevant subsystems and Operations Team in defining a spacecraft operational concept. Contribute to the maintenance of our Model-Based Systems Engineering tools and the integration. Required skills Bachelor or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering or equivalent 5+ years of experience in design, implementation, integration, and V&V of embedded flight software subsystem Operational experience, including preparation of operations, participation in rehearsals and on-console activities. Experience performing FMECA, reliability analysis, and/or hazard analysis Experience with programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or equivalent Self-motivated and comfortable making key decisions within a fast-paced environment High sense of accountability and ownership Excellent presentation skills, both verbally and written. Enthusiastic attitude and team player Working level in English Preferred skills Experience with design, analysis or testing of at least one other subsystem: Structure, Thermal, Avionics, Propulsion, Communications, GNC. Experience with requirement decomposition (mission all the way to unit level) Experience with system level testing such as hardware-in-the-loop testing Working level Japanese We will prioritize candidates currently in Japan with valid working visa. If you are selected for the first stage screening interview, we will aim to contact you within 3 weeks of your application.

review_candidates.title: Chief Financial Officer
review_candidates.description: CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER (CFO) — CAPITAL & PROJECT FINANCE Kamen Construction Limited | Abuja, Nigeria | Full-Time About Kamen Kamen Construction Limited is a Nigerian infrastructure development and construction company delivering roads, drainage, water, electrical infrastructure, buildings and other integrated infrastructure solutions. Through  Kamen Infrastructure Development Services (KAMEN-IDS) , Kamen is developing a structured infrastructure delivery and financing platform that enables governments, real estate developers, corporate organisations, communities and private clients to deliver infrastructure through flexible financing arrangements. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are seeking a commercially driven and highly capable  Chief Financial Officer (CFO)  to lead our financial strategy, capital raising, project finance, investment structuring, treasury and financial governance. This is  not a conventional accounting-focused CFO position . We are looking for a finance leader who can help build Kamen's financial architecture, raise equity and debt, establish project SPVs, structure infrastructure transactions and develop strong relationships with banks, investors, capital houses and institutional funding partners. The Role The CFO will be a key member of Kamen's executive management team and will report directly to the Managing Director/CEO. The successful candidate will lead the company's corporate finance strategy while serving as the financial champion for  KAMEN-IDS and its project-financing platform . The role combines corporate finance, capital raising, project finance, treasury, investment management and financial governance. Key Responsibilities 1. Corporate Finance & Strategy Develop and execute Kamen's financial strategy and capital structure. Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and capital allocation. Provide the CEO and Board with financial and strategic decision support. Improve profitability, cash generation and return on invested capital. Establish strong financial controls, policies and governance. 2. Capital Raising & Investor Relations Develop and execute Kamen's equity and debt capital-raising strategy. Identify and build relationships with private equity funds, infrastructure funds, family offices, banks, development finance institutions, institutional investors, private credit funds and capital-market operators. Prepare investment teasers, information memoranda, financial models and investor presentations. Lead investor discussions, due diligence and transaction negotiations. Build and manage a pipeline of potential investors and financing partners. Lead successful equity investment transactions for Kamen and its projects. 3. KAMEN-IDS Project Finance & SPVs Develop the financial architecture for KAMEN-IDS. Establish and manage appropriate Project Special Purpose Vehicles (SPVs). Structure project-level financing and determine the appropriate mix of equity, debt, client contributions, supplier credit and other funding sources. Develop detailed project financial models covering construction costs, cash flow, revenues, financing costs, profitability, IRR, DSCR, payback and sensitivity analysis. Assess the bankability of projects before financial commitment. Coordinate financial close and project-financing processes. Ensure project funds are appropriately ring-fenced and controlled. Monitor the financial performance of project SPVs. 4. Debt, Debentures & Structured Finance Lead Kamen's debt-financing initiatives. Develop relationships with banks, investment firms, capital houses and private credit providers. Structure and negotiate corporate loans, project finance, debentures, private debt, asset-backed financing, receivables-backed financing, bridge financing and other structured-finance facilities. Negotiate financing terms including pricing, tenor, security, covenants and repayment structures. Coordinate lender due diligence and financial documentation. 5. Treasury & Cash Flow Lead Kamen's treasury function and group-wide cash management. Establish rolling cash-flow forecasts and liquidity controls. Optimise working capital and cash conversion. Manage banking relationships and financing facilities. Ensure proper utilisation of project funds and timely debt servicing. Establish early-warning indicators for liquidity and financial risk. 6. Financial Reporting, Risk & Governance Lead the Finance & Accounts function and ensure accurate and timely management reporting. Strengthen budgeting, variance analysis, receivables and payables management. Coordinate audits, tax compliance and statutory reporting. Develop financial risk-management and internal-control systems. Ensure effective financial governance across Kamen and its project SPVs. 7. Leadership Build and lead a high-performance Finance, Treasury, Investment and Capital Management team. Establish clear KPIs and accountability. Work closely with Projects, Commercial, Procurement, Business Development and Operations to ensure projects are commercially viable and properly funded. Key Performance Measures The CFO will be measured primarily by business outcomes, including: Equity capital successfully raised. Debt and debenture financing successfully secured. Number and value of financing transactions closed. Capital raised for KAMEN-IDS projects. Number of project SPVs established and financed. Successful financial closes. Cost and structure of capital achieved. Project profitability and return on capital. Cash-flow and liquidity performance. Quality of investor and lender relationships. Strength of financial controls and reporting. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or related discipline. Professional qualification such as  ACA, ACCA, CFA, CIMA  or equivalent. Minimum  10–15 years' relevant experience , including substantial senior-management experience. Proven experience in corporate finance, project finance, investment banking, structured finance or infrastructure financing. Demonstrable experience raising equity and/or debt capital. Strong financial-modelling and transaction-structuring skills. Experience negotiating with banks, investors and capital providers. Strong understanding of Nigerian financial and capital markets. Experience in  construction, infrastructure, real estate, private equity, private credit, development finance or investment banking  will be highly advantageous. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for a  builder, not just a financial controller . The ideal candidate must be commercially astute, entrepreneurial, analytical and highly skilled in financial modelling, deal structuring and negotiation. He or she should be comfortable engaging CEOs, investors, fund managers, bankers, government stakeholders and other sophisticated capital providers. Most importantly, candidates must demonstrate  actual transactions completed , not simply experience preparing financial reports. Candidates who have personally led or materially contributed to successful equity raises, debt transactions, debentures, project-finance deals or investment transactions will have a significant advantage. Our Expectation Within the first 12–18 months, the CFO should help Kamen transition from a predominantly construction-company financing model toward an  institutional infrastructure-financing platform , capable of: Originate → Structure → Finance → Execute → Monitor → Recycle Capital across a growing portfolio of infrastructure projects. Application Interested candidates should submit a detailed CV highlighting their experience in  capital raising, corporate finance, project finance, investment banking, debt/equity transactions, and infrastructure financing . Candidates should clearly identify significant transactions they have personally led or materially contributed to, including the approximate value and nature of each transaction.

review_candidates.title: Senior HVDC Construction Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Pattern Energy is a leading renewable energy company that develops, constructs, owns, and operates high-quality wind and solar generation, transmission, and energy storage facilities. Our mission is to transition the world to renewable energy through the sustainable development and responsible operation of facilities with respect for the environment, communities, and cultures where we have a presence. Our approach begins and ends with establishing trust, accountability, and transparency. Our company values of creative spirit, pride of ownership, follow-through, and a team-first attitude drive us to pursue our mission every day. Our culture supports our values by fostering innovative and critical thinking and a deep belief in living up to our promises. Headquartered in the United States, Pattern has a global portfolio of more than 30 power facilities and transmission assets, serving various customers that provide low-cost clean energy to millions of consumers. Responsibilities JOB PURPOSE The purpose of the role is to lead, oversee, coordinate and manage the technical aspect of construction activities to ensure alignment with the engineering design. Ensure that the project is constructed safely, efficiently, and according to the approved designs, specifications and regulations. Ensure compliance with safety regulation, building codes, project specification and stakeholder expectations. Coordinate with contractors, suppliers and stakeholders to ensure deliverables are clearly defended and expectations are being met to keep the project on schedule and within budget. Use technical knowledge and practical experience to address technical related issues with pragmatic and timely solutions, balancing contractual commitments with technical compliance while maintaining a positive working relationship with all stakeholders. Monitor quality control and ensure the project aligns with the approved design. Lead and coordinate all project commissioning actives to ensure the constructed project performs as intended. Lead the coordination of technical stakeholders both internal and external to ensure alignment with project objectives. Ensures successful handoff to operations on project completions. Key Accountabilities Work closely with project managers, design engineers, Owner's Engineer, Contractors, equipment vendor & suppliers and Engineer's of other Stakeholder during project planning and execution to coordinate technical support and ensure seamless integration of HVDC, electrical and structural components. Communicate progress updates, challenges, and needs of project stakeholders through regular reports or meetings. Provide daily technical support to construction activities, including the installation of converter stations, interfacing utilities, interfacing transmission lines, interfacing generation and related equipment. Support the supervision of the construction management team, an provide guidance to subcontractors to ensure tasks are performed correctly and on schedule. Monitor progress to ensure alignment with project timelines and milestones. Ensure that construction work adheres to detailed engineering designs and technical specifications provided by design engineers and stakeholders. Verify that the installation of HVDC components (e.g., converters, transformers, main circuit equipment) matches the intended design and functional requirements. Coordinate with design teams to clarify ambiguities or address discrepancies in plans during construction. Conduct regular inspections of materials, workmanship, and installed equipment to ensure compliance with project standards, manufacturer specifications, and industry regulations (e.g., IEC, IEEE). Oversee or assist in testing procedures during construction, such as insulation resistance tests or high-voltage checks, to validate component integrity before commissioning. Identify and support rectification of any defects or non-conformities in construction processes or materials. Enforce strict safety protocols specific to high-voltage systems to protect workers, equipment, and the public during construction. Ensure compliance with safety standards such as OSHA (or equivalent local regulations) and HVDC-specific safety guidelines, including proper grounding, isolation, and use of personal protective equipment (PPE). Conduct safety briefings, risk assessments, and hazard identification for tasks involving high-voltage equipment or challenging site conditions. Support the develop and preparation of specialized commissioning plans and acceptance criteria for the installation of HVDC transmission systems considering overall generation integration. Review commissioning results and accept or reject based on preestablishes criteria. Coordinate all commissioning activities across all affected stakeholders. Support construction contractors in addressing on-site challenges promptly, such as design gaps and interfacing issues, unexpected ground conditions, equipment malfunctions or damage, material delays, or adverse weather, to minimize disruptions. Support the implementation of practical solutions to technical or logistical issues, such as adjusting construction methods for civil work, structural work, or resolving equipment alignment problems. Collaborate with project managers and engineers to escalate and resolve complex issues that impact project scope or timelines. Support the development and preconstruction team in the planning and assessment of potential new projects. Support the creation of conceptual design and front-end engineering design activities, developing technical specifications, and evaluating proposals. Qualifications Experience/Qualifications/Education Required A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with experience in HVDC design, construction, and operation. 10 years or more of experience as a Professional Engineer with experience in high voltage substation and transmission. At least 10 years’ experience with HVDC design, construction, commissioning, and operations. Additional Requirements Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, strong technical capabilities and a creative, curious, self-driven work ethic. Demonstrated effectiveness in carrying out complex projects and tasks with minimum supervision. Ability to work well in and/or lead cross functional teams with no supervision or oversight Strong oral, written and presentations skills. Ability to travel frequently (Up to 50% travel) Technical Skills Advanced knowledge of application and operation of HVDC technology. Knowledge of HVDC system design including experience with converter valves, valve cooling, converter transformers, reactors/capacitors, and control and protection systems. Experience in preparing technical specifications and tender documents for HVDC converter stations, evaluating bid documents, performing design reviews, witnessing factory tests, construction monitoring and on-site commissioning. Knowledge in review of studies related to HVDC systems including witnessing and reviewing results from factory and on-site testing. Knowledge of applicable codes and standards related to HVDC transmission Field experience with installation, commissioning, and maintenance of HVDC transmission systems. Demonstrated ability in planning, organizing and directing engineering work involving a high degree of specialization. Ability to quickly assess technical issues and evaluate requirements with the ability to develop and implement appropriate action plans Ability to oversee the installation and integration of HVDC systems with existing AC grids or renewable energy sources like wind or solar farms. Expertise in the installation of high-voltage AC and DC cables, both underground and submarine, including trenching, jointing, and termination techniques. Skills in managing the assembly and installation of converter station equipment, including cooling systems, control systems, and high-voltage insulation. Ability to oversee civil works such as site grading, foundation construction for towers and converter stations, and ensuring stability for heavy equipment. Understanding of soil and ground conditions to support cable laying or tower foundations, especially in challenging terrains. Knowledge of structural requirements for supporting high-voltage equipment and ensuring durability against environmental factors like wind or seismic activity. Basic proficiency in AutoCAD or similar software to interpret and review design drawings for converter stations and transmission lines. Understanding of safety protocols specific to high-voltage environments, including electrical isolation, grounding, and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements. Familiarity with international standards for HVDC systems, such as IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission) and IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) guidelines, as well as local electrical codes. The expected starting pay range for this role is $128,000 - $173,000 USD. This range is an estimate and base pay may be above or below the ranges based on several factors including but not limited to location, work experience, certifications, and education. In addition to base pay, Pattern’s compensation program includes a bonus structure for full-time employees of all levels. We also provide a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, voluntary benefits, family care benefits, employee assistance program, paid time off and bonding leave, paid holidays, 401(k)/RRSP retirement savings plan with employer contribution, and employee referral bonuses. Pattern Energy Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

review_candidates.title: Project Funding and Financing Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Brief (Re-advertise) Leads project financing and investment readiness to mobilise funding for sustainable infrastructure and climate initiatives. Project Funding and Financing Lead Program Background KINETIK, the Australia-Indonesia Climate and Sustainable Infrastructure Partnership, supports Indonesia to strengthen sustainable infrastructure systems, mobilise climate-aligned investment, and advance low-emissions and climate-resilient development. Working with the Government of Indonesia (GOI) and a broad network of public and private partners, the program seeks to expand investment in sustainable infrastructure while ensuring the inclusion of local communities, particularly women, girls and people with disabilities. KINETIK contributes to three inter-related End of Program Outcomes (EOPOs): Climate resilience: Investments from government, private and community actors increasingly contribute to climate mitigation and adaptation in Indonesia. Innovative financing: GOI increasingly uses diverse, innovative and high-quality financing to support inclusive, climate-resilient development. Sustainable infrastructure: GOI delivers sustainable and resilient economic infrastructure, particularly in water, transport and energy, that meets the needs of communities, including women, people with disabilities and marginalised groups. The program builds on long-standing Australia-Indonesia cooperation in infrastructure and climate policy. review_candidates.title: Project Construction & Commissioning Manager
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Project Construction & Commissioning Manager (PCCM) to support the delivery of a major HVDC interconnector project connecting France and Spain. Based in Massy, France, and working across both countries, you will play a critical role in the construction of converter stations as part of a large-scale energy infrastructure programme. You will lead project mobilisation, construction readiness, execution oversight, and commissioning activities while working closely with the Site Manager, Project Director, construction partners, and key stakeholders. This role offers the opportunity to work on a strategically important cross-border project that supports Europe's energy transition. The successful candidate will bring strong construction leadership, stakeholder management expertise, and the ability to influence delivery partners in a complex EPC environment. Your Impact Lead and coordinate all Construction & Commissioning activities across the project lifecycle, from project handover through execution and close-out. Manage the transfer from Tender to Construction, reviewing scope, schedule, budget, risks, opportunities, and execution strategy. Organise and lead Construction & Commissioning kick-off activities, ensuring project readiness and alignment across key stakeholders. Drive mobilisation activities and support the development and implementation of site execution plans. Coordinate with the Site Manager to ensure effective planning, resource allocation, site infrastructure development, and project mobilisation. Lead constructability reviews and ensure construction strategies developed during the tender phase are implemented throughout project execution. Prepare and manage plans relating to storage, preservation, maintenance, and site-specific spare parts. Manage interfaces with construction partners, contractors, subcontractors, and key project stakeholders to support successful project delivery. Monitor construction progress, productivity, costs, forecasts, and schedule performance, implementing mitigation and recovery plans where required. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, project procedures, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Maintain awareness of labour laws, permits, licences, HSE requirements, and project-specific certifications required for site execution. Work closely with HSE, Quality, Engineering, Procurement, and Project Controls teams to achieve project objectives. Coordinate subcontracted activities alongside the Site Subcontract Manager and ensure alignment with project plans and delivery targets. Manage and coordinate Non-Budgeted Costs (NBCs) and support accurate financial reporting and forecasting. Provide regular reporting to the Project Director and Construction Management, highlighting progress, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions. Ensure that resources are mobilised and deployed effectively throughout the project lifecycle while balancing performance, schedule, and cost requirements. Represent the site team in home-office-related activities and support effective communication between site and project leadership. Coordinate construction disciplines to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality delivery of the project scope. Ensure HVDC Construction & Commissioning processes, procedures, and guidelines are implemented and adhered to. Drive continuous improvement through lessons learned, structured feedback, and constructability reviews during execution and site close-out. Your Background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related technical discipline. Proven experience in Construction Management, Construction & Commissioning Management, Project Construction Management, Site Management, or similar leadership roles within major infrastructure, energy, or EPC projects. Experience delivering HVDC projects, transmission projects, substations, power generation facilities, or large-scale EPC projects. Strong construction and site execution background, including experience in mobilisation and multi-disciplinary project delivery. Experience managing contractors, consortium partners, joint venture organisations, or complex delivery partner environments. Preference will be given to candidates with significant civil construction experience. Strong understanding of project controls, budgeting, forecasting, risk management, and construction planning. Demonstrated ability to negotiate and influence stakeholders across multiple organisations and project functions. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to maintain a strategic overview while remaining focused on detailed project execution. Strong quality mindset and commitment to safe project delivery. Languages Fluent English is required. Fluency in either French or Spanish is required. Fluency in all three languages would be advantageous. More About Us Join a business at the forefront of the energy transition, delivering complex and impactful infrastructure projects that strengthen the future of power transmission across Europe. You will work within an international environment on a high-profile cross-border HVDC project, collaborating with experienced professionals across engineering, construction, commissioning, and project management disciplines. We offer professional development opportunities, international exposure, career mobility, flexible working arrangements, and a competitive compensation and benefits package. L’opportunité Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Construction & Mise en Service de Projet (Project Construction & Commissioning Manager – PCCM) expérimenté(e) pour accompagner la réalisation d’un important projet d’interconnexion HVDC reliant la France et l’Espagne. Basé(e) à Massy (France) et intervenant sur les deux pays, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans la construction des postes de conversion dans le cadre d’un programme d’infrastructure énergétique de grande envergure. Vous serez responsable de la mobilisation du projet, de la préparation des activités de construction, du pilotage de l’exécution et des activités de mise en service, tout en collaborant étroitement avec le Responsable de Chantier, le Directeur de Projet, les partenaires de construction et les principales parties prenantes. Ce poste offre l’opportunité de contribuer à un projet transfrontalier stratégique soutenant la transition énergétique européenne. Le candidat idéal apportera une solide expérience en management de la construction, une excellente capacité à gérer les parties prenantes et à influencer les partenaires de réalisation dans un environnement EPC complexe. Votre impact Diriger et coordonner l’ensemble des activités de Construction et de Mise en Service tout au long du cycle de vie du projet, depuis son transfert jusqu’à son exécution et sa clôture. Gérer la transition entre les phases d’Offre (Tender) et de Construction, en examinant le périmètre, le planning, le budget, les risques, les opportunités et la stratégie d’exécution. Organiser et piloter les activités de lancement (kick-off) Construction & Mise en Service, en garantissant la préparation du projet et l’alignement de l’ensemble des parties prenantes. Piloter les activités de mobilisation et soutenir l’élaboration ainsi que la mise en œuvre des plans d’exécution du chantier. Coordonner avec le Responsable de Chantier la planification, l’allocation des ressources, le développement des infrastructures du site et les activités de mobilisation. Diriger les revues de constructibilité et veiller à la mise en œuvre des stratégies de construction définies lors de la phase d’appel d’offres tout au long de l’exécution du projet. Préparer et gérer les plans relatifs au stockage, à la préservation, à la maintenance et aux pièces de rechange spécifiques au chantier. Gérer les interfaces avec les partenaires de construction, les entreprises, les sous-traitants et les principales parties prenantes afin de garantir la réussite du projet. Suivre l’avancement des travaux, la productivité, les coûts, les prévisions budgétaires et la performance du planning, et mettre en place des actions correctives et des plans de redressement lorsque nécessaire. Veiller au respect des obligations contractuelles, des procédures projet ainsi que des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables. Maintenir une bonne connaissance de la législation du travail, des permis, des autorisations, des exigences HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) et des certifications spécifiques nécessaires à l’exécution sur site. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes HSE, Qualité, Ingénierie, Achats et Contrôle de Projet afin d’atteindre les objectifs du projet. Coordonner les activités sous-traitées en collaboration avec le Responsable des Sous-traitants du site et garantir leur alignement avec les plans et objectifs du projet. Gérer et coordonner les coûts hors budget (NBC – Non-Budgeted Costs) et contribuer à l’exactitude des reportings financiers et des prévisions. Fournir des rapports réguliers au Directeur de Projet et à la Direction Construction, mettant en évidence l’avancement, les risques, les opportunités et les actions correctives. Garantir la mobilisation et le déploiement efficaces des ressources tout au long du cycle de vie du projet tout en conciliant performance, délais et maîtrise des coûts. Représenter l’équipe chantier dans les activités liées au siège et favoriser une communication efficace entre le site et la direction du projet. Coordonner les différentes disciplines de construction afin d’assurer une exécution sûre, efficace et de haute qualité du périmètre du projet. Veiller à la mise en œuvre et au respect des processus, procédures et directives HVDC relatifs à la Construction et à la Mise en Service. Promouvoir l’amélioration continue à travers les retours d’expérience, les retours structurés et les revues de constructibilité pendant l’exécution et la clôture du chantier. Votre profil Diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master) ou équivalent en Ingénierie, Management de la Construction, Gestion de Projet ou dans une discipline technique connexe. Expérience confirmée en Management de la Construction, Management Construction & Mise en Service, Gestion de Construction de Projet, Direction de Chantier ou dans des fonctions de leadership similaires au sein de grands projets d’infrastructure, d’énergie ou EPC. Expérience dans la réalisation de projets HVDC, de transport d’électricité, de postes électriques, d’installations de production d’énergie ou de grands projets EPC. Solide expérience de la construction et de l’exécution sur site, incluant la mobilisation et la réalisation de projets multidisciplinaires. Expérience dans la gestion d’entreprises, de partenaires de consortium, de coentreprises (joint-ventures) ou d’environnements complexes impliquant de multiples partenaires de réalisation. Une expérience significative en travaux de génie civil constituera un atout majeur. Excellente compréhension du contrôle de projet, de la gestion budgétaire, des prévisions, de la gestion des risques et de la planification des travaux. Capacité démontrée à négocier et à influencer des parties prenantes issues de différentes organisations et fonctions projet. Excellentes compétences en leadership, communication et gestion des parties prenantes. Capacité à conserver une vision stratégique tout en restant concentré(e) sur l’excellence de l’exécution opérationnelle. Forte culture qualité et engagement constant en faveur de la sécurité des projets. Langues Anglais courant obligatoire. Maîtrise courante du français ou de l’espagnol obligatoire. La maîtrise des trois langues (anglais, français et espagnol) serait un atout appréciable. Plus d’informations sur nous Rejoignez une entreprise à l’avant-garde de la transition énergétique, réalisant des projets d’infrastructure complexes et à fort impact qui contribuent à renforcer l’avenir du transport d’électricité à travers l’Europe. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement international au sein d’un projet HVDC transfrontalier de premier plan, en collaboration avec des professionnels expérimentés des domaines de l’ingénierie, de la construction, de la mise en service et de la gestion de projet. Nous offrons des opportunités de développement professionnel, une exposition internationale, des perspectives de mobilité de carrière, des modalités de travail flexibles ainsi qu’un package de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux compétitif. Publication date : 2026-07-09

review_candidates.title: Deputy Director Financing and Delivery
review_candidates.description: Job Brief (Re-advertise) KINETIK is seeking qualified professionals for the role of Deputy Director Financing and Delivery to support program delivery and implementation in Jakarta, Indonesia. Deputy Director Financing and Delivery Program Background KINETIK, the Australia-Indonesia Climate and Sustainable Infrastructure Partnership, supports Indonesia to strengthen sustainable infrastructure systems, mobilise climate-aligned investment, and advance low-emissions and climate-resilient development. Working with the Government of Indonesia (GOI) and a broad network of public and private partners, the program seeks to expand investment in sustainable infrastructure while ensuring the inclusion of local communities, particularly women, girls and people with disabilities. KINETIK contributes to three inter-related End of Program Outcomes (EOPOs): Climate resilience: Investments from government, private and community actors increasingly contribute to climate mitigation and adaptation in Indonesia. Innovative financing: GOI increasingly uses diverse, innovative and high-quality financing to support inclusive, climate-resilient development. Sustainable infrastructure: GOI delivers sustainable and resilient economic infrastructure, particularly in water, transport and energy, that meets the needs of communities, including women, people with disabilities and marginalised groups. The program builds on long-standing Australia-Indonesia cooperation in infrastructure and climate policy. It promotes locally led development, integrates gender equality, disability and social inclusion (GEDSI), and works with development finance and private sector partners to mobilise investment and support sustainable infrastructure systems across sectors including renewable energy, water, sanitation and waste management, and sustainable transport. KINETIK is supported by the Australian Government’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented by DT Global. About DT Global Asia Pacific At DT Global Asia Pacific, we aim to positively impact people’s lives through delivery excellence. As a leading implementing partner across Asia and the Pacific, we co-create locally led solutions in partnership with governments, communities, and stakeholders. We bring together talented teams and deep regional expertise to deliver initiatives that promote inclusive economic growth, essential services, and resilient, secure communities. With over 1,500 staff, experts in 22+ countries and more than 60 years of development experience, we tackle complex community, national and transnational challenges — from governance and justice systems to climate resilience, infrastructure and social equity — with innovative thinking and a commitment to long-term impact. For more information, please see www.dt-global.com The Role The Deputy Director Financing and Delivery (DD F&D) is a senior executive position responsible for KINETIK’s Financing and Delivery pillar, encompassing infrastructure, climate-resilient development, and investment mobilisation. The role provides strategic portfolio-wide leadership across the F&D pillar, ensuring effective delivery of climate-resilient investments and mobilisation of climate-aligned financing across the full KINETIK partnership. The role is accountable for ensuring that KINETIK delivers a credible, investment-oriented portfolio that translates policy ambition into financed and implementable outcomes The role is accountable for setting the strategic direction and performance of KINETIK’s Financing and Delivery pillar, ensuring that priority infrastructure and climate opportunities progress from early-stage identification through to financing and implementation. This includes overseeing the development of a coherent pipeline aligned with Government of Indonesia priorities, DFAT objectives, and KINETIK’s EOPOs, and ensuring that infrastructure, climate, and financing elements are effectively sequenced end-to-end. Financing within KINETIK refers to translating climate and infrastructure opportunities into investible and implementable outcomes. KINETIK will do this in two ways. First, through supporting priority GoI climate and infrastructure projects through project preparation, investment readiness, financial and commercial structuring, mobilisation of capital and development of innovative financing approaches through government, development finance and private sector partners. Second, through private sector development based approaches, working to build Indonesia’s innovative financing ecosystem and capital markets to crowd in additional financing for Indonesia’s climate and infrastructure priorities. The Deputy Director Financing and Delivery provides portfolio-level leadership across this function, including setting priorities, allocating resources, and monitoring performance. Technical execution of financing and transactions activities is led by the Head of Financing and Transactions, while sector delivery is led by the Head of Climate Resilient Development. This role is prioritised for a suitably qualified Indonesian and international candidates with strong public and/or private finance credentials and established networks with Indonesian government and financial institutions. Candidates with demonstrated senior leadership experience in infrastructure, climate finance, or development finance are strongly encouraged to apply. As a member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), the DD F&D contributes to strategic decision-making and program governance. The role coordinates with the Deputy Director Policy, Partnerships, and Inclusion (PPI) to ensure end-to-end coherence across sector engagement, from policy and regulatory reform through to financing and delivery, and leads engagement with DFAT on Financing and Delivery matters. The DD F&D enables sector Leads (covering Renewable Energy, Sustainable Transport and Urban Connectivity, as well as Water, Sanitation and Solid Waste) to engage across KINETIK on policy, partnerships, and inclusion relevant to their sectors, and orchestrates cross-pillar sequencing where required. KINETIK senior leadership roles are currently being recruited concurrently. DT Global will consider candidates across aligned technical and management profiles, with final role configuration and responsibilities calibrated to ensure the strongest overall leadership team composition across the Financing and Delivery, Climate Resilient Development, and Financing and Transactions functions. Click on the link or copy paste it to access the full Terms of Reference for this position: https://tinyurl.com/depdirfd About You Essential Experience and Knowledge Postgraduate qualification in engineering, finance, economics, environmental science, or a related field. Minimum 15 years of experience in infrastructure, climate finance, or development finance, including significant experience at senior leadership level on large, complex programs or within government/financial institutions. Extensive senior-level experience in infrastructure financing, investment mobilisation, transaction advisory, innovative financing, blended finance and/or sustainable finance, including engagement with government, development finance institutions, commercial financiers or institutional investors. Strong track record of engaging with government, development finance institutions, and private sector investors at senior levels. Experience with DFAT-funded programs or similar donor-funded development initiatives. Strong understanding of Indonesian infrastructure and financing contexts. Excellent communication, negotiation, and representational skills. Desirable Indonesian national with established networks within GOI infrastructure and finance agencies. Experience with innovative finance approaches, sustainable finance instruments, or capital markets development. Experience integrating GEDSI considerations into infrastructure or financing activities. Indonesian language skills (for international applicants). Why join KINETIK? By joining the KINETIK, you will be part of an environment where you can collaborate with leading experts from diverse backgrounds, access development programs to achieve your career goals, and be challenged to take a global outlook. How To Apply Click the ' Apply Now ' button. Please submit Your CV A cover letter addressing the selection criteria Your response to each of the Selection Criterion (required to be considered for shortlisting) In addressing the Selection Criteria, please provide relevant examples of how your qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience meet the requirements of the role (applicants may refer to DT Global’s guidance on addressing selection criteria for tips on preparing your response). Only applications that address the selection criteria will be considered for further assessment. APPLICATIONS CLOSE 25 September 2026, 23:59 WIB (UTC+7) (Indonesia Western Time). Should this role be of interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Kindly note only shortlisted applicants will be contacted. People with lived experience of the regions in which DT Global operates are strongly encouraged to apply. DT Global welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds including First Nations peoples, diverse Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Expression, and Sex Characteristics (SOGIESC), and people with disabilities. We take a zero-tolerance approach to sexual exploitation, abuse and harm of adults and children; fraud, corruption and bribery; modern slavery; and any form of exploitation across our operations, partnerships, and supply chains. We uphold the highest standards of integrity and expect the same of those we work with. Engagement with DT Global is subject to formal background screening, criminal record checks, employment verification, and periodic compliance checks. All DT Global staff receive safety, compliance, safeguarding and integrity training, and we expect our personnel and partners to always act in alignment with our company values.

Contract, Procurement & Cost Support Assist project teams in preparing and evaluating engineering and construction contractor Requests for Proposals (RFPs). Support cost estimating and procurement of project civil works and site infrastructure. Due Diligence & Risk Assist with technical due diligence for potential renewable project acquisitions, including site suitability, geotechnical and constructability considerations. Support risk management by escalating technical issues and potential schedule risks. Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement Participate in meetings with consultants, contractors and suppliers to help manage engineering deliverables and schedules. Participate in internal project team meetings and present on technical issues or risks. Lead meetings and coordination between contractors and authorities having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with permitting and site development requirements. Operations Support Provide technical support to the operations teams as required for operating projects. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Experience with site civil design — foundations, grading, drainage and stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, and access roads. Experience with geotechnical investigation and its application to renewable project design. Experience with complex, large-scale engineering projects. Ability to manage multiple projects and activities and organize work to meet deadlines. Strong and effective written and verbal communication skills. Technical Skills Proficiency with civil design and drafting tools and familiarity with hydrology/drainage and grading software to aid in design reviews. Proficiency with using AI tools including Copilot and Claude co-work. Familiarity with project-scheduling tools (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project). Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook). Ability to travel throughout North America, although travel to project sites is not a primary responsibility of the role. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering. Minimum of 5 years of experience in renewable energy projects or projects with transferrable skills. Registered P.Eng in at least one province in Canada. Compensation Base salary range: $110,000 to $130,000 CAD, commensurate with experience. Target annual bonus: 10% of base salary. Compensation will vary depending on experience and qualifications. Benefits Extended health and dental benefits. RRSP matching program. Paid parental leave. Professional development support. DIVERSITY & INCLUSION Potentia Renewables is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and encourage candidates from underrepresented communities to apply. AI IN OUR HIRING PROCESS As part of our commitment to an efficient and fair recruitment process, Potentia may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help screen and assess applications. These tools support our team’s decision-making, and all final hiring decisions are made by people. DEADLINE Applications will be accepted until a qualified talent pool is compiled. review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Lead - HRH Development and Regulation
review_candidates.description: Overview The Senior Technical Lead – Human Resources for Health (HRH) Development & Regulation provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and quality assurance for the project's Health Workforce Development and Professional Regulation portfolio under RISE and ASCEND HRH activities The position leads implementation of interventions that strengthen the production, competency, regulation, certification, and continuous professional development of Ethiopia's health workforce while ensuring that national institutions develop sustainable systems capable of continuously improving workforce quality beyond the life of the project. The project supports the Government of Ethiopia to strengthen Human Resources for Health (HRH) systems, particularly in underserved and fragile settings where shortages of competent health workers, limited institutional capacity, and weak regulatory systems continue to affect access to quality primary health care. Working through national institutions and decentralized implementation platforms, the project advances sustainable, country-led HRH reforms that improve workforce competency, performance, resilience, and health system effectiveness. Working closely with the Ministry of Health (MoH), Ministry of Education (MoE), Educational and Training Authority (ETA), Health Professionals Licensing Lead Executive Office (LEO), higher education institutions (HEIs), professional associations (PAs), teaching hospitals, regulatory agencies, and development partners, the Senior Technical Lead provides strategic direction across the education-to-practice continuum, including competency-based pre-service education, educational quality assurance, accreditation, faculty development, simulation-based education, continuing professional development (CPD), competency assessment, national licensing examinations, professional licensing, certification, and professional regulation. The position serves as Jhpiego's principal technical authority for this pillar, ensuring that all interventions are technically sound, evidence-based, innovative, well integrated, and aligned with Ethiopia's Human Resources for Health Strategic and Investment Plan, national regulatory frameworks, the America First Global Health Strategy (AFGHS), and other relevant national priorities. The Senior Technical Lead also promotes institutional capacity strengthening, country ownership, sustainability, adaptive management, and continuous technical innovation across the portfolio. Position is contingent on MOH and donor guidance. Responsibilities Strategic Technical Leadership Provide overall strategic leadership for all activities related to competency-based pre-service education, educational quality improvement, accreditation, faculty development, simulation-based education, continuing professional development, competency assessment, national licensing examinations, professional licensing, certification, and professional regulation. Lead development and refinement of technical strategies that strengthen the education-to-practice continuum for Ethiopia's health workforce. Identify, adapt, and promote global and national best practices that improve health professions education, competency assessment, professional regulation, and lifelong learning. Ensure all technical approaches are evidence-based, implementation-oriented, and responsive to Ethiopia's evolving HRH priorities. Guide annual technical planning, priority setting, resource allocation, and implementation sequencing across the project. Technical Oversight of Project Objectives Provide strategic oversight for implementation of all interventions to produce competent, practice-ready, and continuously learning health workforce Ensure technical coherence and high-quality implementation across all thematic areas including: Competency-based pre-service education Educational quality assurance and accreditation Continuing professional development Competency assessment and licensing Professional regulation Ensure technical consistency across central, regional, subnational, and partner implementation teams. Coordinate closely with other Technical Leads to ensure seamless integration across all project objectives and avoid fragmented implementation. National Technical Leadership and Government Engagement Serve as Jhpiego's principal technical focal point for HRH Development and Regulation with the MoH, MoE, ETA, Health Professional Competency Assessment and Licensing (HPCAL) LEO, HEIs, PAs, regulatory agencies, and development partners. Provide high-level technical assistance to national institutions in strengthening policies, standards, implementation frameworks, operational guidelines, and institutional systems. Lead or contribute to national technical working groups, advisory committees, policy dialogues, and strategic planning processes. Cultivate and maintain productive working relationships with government counterparts and development partners to promote harmonization, institutional ownership, and sustainability. Ensure project investments strengthen—not duplicate—existing national systems and government priorities. Technical Quality Assurance Ensure all technical interventions meet national standards, international best practices, and donor expectations. Lead quality assurance for development and review of national educational guidelines, standard operating procedures, competency frameworks, competency/outcome-based curricula, accreditation program standards, assessment blueprints, workplace-based assessment tools, licensing procedures, simulation packages, digital learning resources, and technical manuals. Review and approve major technical deliverables before dissemination. Ensure interventions remain technically sound, operationally feasible, and responsive to emerging national priorities. Innovation and Technical Advancement Champion innovative approaches that modernize health professions education and professional regulation, including AI-enabled education, digital learning, learning management systems, clinical simulation, workplace-based assessment, digital accreditation, digital licensing, computer-based testing, psychometric analytics, and learning analytics. Monitor emerging global evidence and identify innovations appropriate for adaptation within Ethiopia. Promote implementation science and continuous improvement across technical interventions. Institutional Capacity Strengthening and Technical Mentorship Strengthen institutional capacity of government agencies, higher education institutions, regulatory bodies, professional associations, and teaching hospitals to independently sustain HRH reforms. Provide high-level technical mentoring and coaching to Senior Advisors, Subnational Technical Team, government counterparts, and partner organizations. Support development of national technical expertise and succession planning. Foster multidisciplinary collaboration and strengthen communities of practice that promote continuous learning and technical excellence. Technical Integration and Systems Strengthening Ensure seamless integration among competency-based education, accreditation, CPD, competency assessment, licensing, professional regulation, HRH digital systems, quality improvement, workforce planning, and evidence generation. Coordinate closely with the Senior Technical Lead – Leadership & Workforce Systems to maximize technical synergies across project objectives. Promote integrated implementation approaches that strengthen institutional systems rather than isolated interventions. Ensure interventions contribute to sustainable health systems strengthening and long-term government ownership. Monitoring, Learning and Adaptive Management Use program data, implementation evidence, and routine monitoring findings to assess technical performance and implementation quality. Identify implementation successes, challenges, risks, bottlenecks, and emerging opportunities. Recommend corrective actions and technical adaptations that improve program effectiveness. Support adaptive management through regular technical reviews, learning sessions, after-action reviews, and performance reflection meetings. Work closely with the MEL team to strengthen evidence generation and utilization for continuous improvement. Knowledge Management, Research, and Business Development Lead development of technical briefs, implementation guides, policy briefs, technical reports, success stories, case studies, conference abstracts, peer-reviewed publications, and other knowledge products. Promote documentation and dissemination of innovations, lessons learned, and best practices nationally and internationally. Foster organizational learning and strengthen technical communities of practice across project partners. Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, leveraged investments, and future HRH programming. Contribute technical expertise to proposal development, concept notes, strategic planning, and organizational business development initiatives as requested. Representation Represent Jhpiego in national and international technical working groups, conferences, scientific meetings, donor consultations, academic forums, regulatory meetings, and professional networks. Present technical achievements, innovations, research findings, and lessons learned through conferences, publications, and policy dialogues. Strengthen Jhpiego's reputation as a national and global leader in HRH systems strengthening. Cross-Cutting Responsibilities Promote country ownership, institutional strengthening, localization, sustainability, and transition planning across all interventions. Ensure integration of safeguarding, ethics, digital transformation, quality improvement, and knowledge management throughout the technical portfolio. Strengthen collaboration across technical pillars to ensure delivery of one integrated HRH systems strengthening program. Support organizational learning, strategic planning, proposal development, and other corporate priorities as assigned by the Technical Director or Country Director. Model Jhpiego's values by promoting integrity, accountability, collaboration, innovation, excellence, and respect in all aspects of project implementation. review_candidates.title: Senior Associate, Innovation and Data Integration
review_candidates.description: About Evidence Action At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations. Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions. Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains. Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children. Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives. At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions. The Role You will oversee data systems and analytics for Evidence Action's new In-Line Chlorination Innovation Team, under the Safe Water Now Program. Evidence Action's Safe Water Now program provides access to safe drinking water across Kenya, Uganda, Malawi, and India through water chlorination. Backed by rigorous research showing chlorination can reduce child mortality by more than 20%, safe water is one of the most cost-effective health interventions globally. The program's newest intervention, In-Line Chlorination (ILC), automatically treats water as it flows through piped systems, requiring less behavior change from end users than existing solutions. As ILC scales up, core questions remain about how to optimize device performance, reduce operational costs, and strengthen community engagement. Answering these questions well will shape whether ILC can become a scalable, cost-effective model reaching millions more people. Evidence Action is investing in a dedicated Innovation team to find those answers. This new team will conduct rapid field pilots testing improvements to the ILC model. Your job is to make sure those pilots produce data the team can trust and act on. You will design the data collection tools, build the dashboards, and own the pipeline from field measurement to operational decision. This is not a monitoring or evaluation role: the goal is to get useful information into the hands of field staff and program managers fast enough to change what happens next. Based in Mbale, Uganda, you will report to the Manager, Innovation & Learning, and work closely with both Field Technicians and the MLE Team. Direct Reports Innovation Monitoring Officers Responsibilities Data Collection Design and Quality: Design and oversee data collection processes that produce reliable field data across the Innovation team's device portfolio Supervise a data collection team that conducts spotchecks of data collected by field technicians Build and iterate on survey instruments and collection protocols tailored to each pilot's learning goals Train field technicians on data collection procedures and conduct regular quality checks Identify and troubleshoot data quality issues as they emerge, including measurement inconsistencies, protocol deviations, and instrument problems Support pilot design by helping define what to measure, how to measure it, and what thresholds would indicate success or failure Data Systems and Dashboards: Build and maintain the data pipeline from field collection through to usable outputs Design and manage operational dashboards from the ground up tracking device performance, dosing consistency, visit frequency, and other pilot-specific indicators Own the data cleaning and transformation process, working with MLE teams where appropriate Data-Driven Decision Support: Integrate data from dashboards you create into timely, actionable input for the team's weekly planning and pilot decisions Embed data into weekly workplanning by producing clear signals on which devices need attention, which pilots are on track, and where adjustments are needed Support creation of decision processes across the program that directly utilize and integrate data effectively Analyze emerging pilot results and present findings to the team lead and field staff in accessible, non-technical terms Flag when data is insufficient or unreliable rather than forcing conclusions from weak evidence Key Performance Indicators Data Quality and Integrity: You will be assessed on the accuracy and reliability of field data, including whether quality issues are caught early and resolved. This includes overseeing the performance of data collection officers Data System Delivery: You will be assessed on whether the Innovation team has functioning, reliable data infrastructure, including collection tools, dashboards, and a clean pipeline from field to decision. Speed matters: the time from field collection to usable analysis should be short enough to inform weekly decisions Data Integration into Decisions: You will be assessed on whether pilot data is consistently embedded into the team's weekly planning and pilot design decisions, and whether the team finds the tools and outputs useful enough to actually rely on Requirements Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Public Health, or a related field. Possession of a post graduate qualification in M&E, Statistics, Data Science or related field will be added advantage 4+ years of experience in data management, program analytics, business intelligence, or applied research in a field-based setting. Candidates from a variety of backgrounds are welcome, including private sector Proficiency in statistical software (STATA, R, or similar) and experience building dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, or similar) Experience building data systems or processes from scratch, not just maintaining existing ones Strong communication skills including ability to present technical findings to non-technical audiences Comfort with ambiguity and rapid iteration Fluency in English; local language skills an advantage Willingness to be based in Mbale, Uganda with 50%+ field travel Position Location This role will be based in Mbale, Uganda , with regular travel to field sites. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of Uganda employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Uganda for roles based in Uganda. Note: Applications will be reviewed on rolling basis. Benefits Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide*. Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance (medical cover for self and dependents) Pension/Retirement savings options Paid leave Avenues for engagement and recognition

The role holder ensures that people decisions affecting international programme staff are proportionate, timely and grounded in operational reality, while safeguarding independence from programme management and maintaining consistent standards of HR support across regions. About HALO HALO is the leading global NGO addressing the impact and drivers of conflict in 30 countries and territories, with over 8,000 staff. Most of our staff are local employees and include a growing number of women. Our primary duty is to serve people affected by conflict, clearing landmines and the explosive remnants of war that threaten lives and livelihoods long after fighting has finished. We make land safe where war has ended, while also assisting those affected by active conflict and endemic violence. HALO addresses human suffering caused by armed violence in some of the world’s most fragile places, securing weapons and ammunition and working with both state and community actors to reduce the prevalence of armed violence. About The Role The role covers all HR partnering activity for HALO's country programmes. It operates across multiple jurisdictions and employment frameworks and within varied funding models, including grant funded and fixed period contractual arrangements. The role does not hold line management accountability for country (national) teams. Authority is exercised through professional judgement, influence and established governance, including determining escalation and acting as the senior HR adviser on complex people, safeguarding and workforce matters across HALO's programmes. Responsibilities Strategic People Partnership: Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on workforce, employee relations, leadership and organisational capability matters. Oversee workforce planning and contracting approaches suited to different operating contexts, ensuring structures remain flexible enough for programmes to scale capacity up and down as operational need changes. Employee Relations And Safeguarding Act as the senior HR partner to programme leadership on complex people, safeguarding and duty of care matters, providing expert, decision-focused advice that supports timely and proportionate resolution, but with programme leadership retaining ownership of decisions and outcomes. Support programme leaders to anticipate and address people challenges arising in fragile, high-risk and resource-constrained operating environments. Ensure that significant people and safeguarding considerations are appropriately communicated to Executive and Board stakeholders, with clear articulation of context, options and mitigations. Policy Application And Standards Interpret and apply global HR policies within diverse local and legal contexts, exercising professional judgement where policy intent, donor conditions and operational reality intersect. Support programme leadership to understand and meet their legal, safeguarding and people-management obligations across multiple jurisdictions, balancing compliance with operational effectiveness. Assurance And Risk Support the delivery of the HR assurance programme through reviews of workforce practices, employee relations, safeguarding, duty of care and people management arrangements across programmes. review_candidates.description: ERP MÜDÜRÜ Şirket Hakkında Efor Holding, köklü ticari birikimini yenilikçi vizyonuyla birleştirerek Türkiye’nin farklı sektörlerinde sürdürülebilir değer üreten güçlü bir holding yapısıdır. Çay, kömür, gübre, hububat, enerji, sigorta, filo yönetimi ve gayrimenkul yatırım alanlarında faaliyet gösteren grup şirketleriyle; kalite, güven, operasyonel mükemmeliyet ve sürdürülebilir büyüme ilkeleri doğrultusunda ülke ekonomisine katkı sağlamaktadır. Efor Holding bünyesinde, grup şirketlerimizin ERP altyapısının etkin şekilde yönetilmesi, süreçlerin dijitalleştirilmesi ve sürekli geliştirilmesinden sorumlu olacak ERP Müdürü arıyoruz. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Üniversitelerin Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği, Endüstri Mühendisliği, Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri (YBS) veya ilgili bölümlerinden mezun, ERP sistemleri alanında en az 7 yıl, CANIAS ERP alanında en az 5 yıl deneyimli, CANIAS ERP'nin kurulum, yapılandırma, geliştirme, entegrasyon, bakım ve kullanıcı yönetimi süreçlerinde deneyimli, CANIAS ERP projelerinde analiz, tasarım, test, canlıya geçiş ve proje sonrası destek süreçlerini yönetmiş, Finans, muhasebe, satın alma, satış, stok, üretim, lojistik ve insan kaynakları gibi farklı iş süreçlerinin CANIAS ERP üzerindeki işleyişine hâkim, İş birimlerinin ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek CANIAS ERP üzerinde çözüm üretebilen, İş analizi, süreç tasarımı, süreç iyileştirme ve proje yönetimi konularında deneyimli, CANIAS ERP ile diğer uygulamalar arasında entegrasyon, veri aktarımı ve veri yönetimi süreçlerine hâkim, CANIAS ERP performansı, veri kalitesi, yetkilendirme, erişim güvenliği ve kullanıcı yönetimi konularında deneyimli, Raporlama, dashboard ve yönetim bilgi sistemleri çözümlerinin geliştirilmesine liderlik edebilen, Teknik ekipler ile iş birimleri arasında koordinasyonu sağlayabilecek güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, Ekip yönetimi ve liderlik deneyimi bulunan, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve sonuç odaklı çalışma yetkinliklerine sahip, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Tercihen farklı sektörlerde faaliyet gösteren şirketlerde CANIAS ERP dönüşüm/proje deneyimi bulunan. Grup şirketlerinin CANIAS ERP sisteminin uçtan uca yönetimini ve sürekli geliştirilmesini sağlamak, Kullanıcı taleplerini analiz ederek önceliklendirmek ve çözüm süreçlerini yönetmek, İş birimleriyle birlikte mevcut süreçleri analiz ederek ERP üzerinde süreç iyileştirme ve standardizasyon projeleri geliştirmek, CANIAS ERP'nin yapılandırma ve özelleştirme süreçlerini yönetmek, Yeni modül, fonksiyon ve uygulamaların devreye alınmasına liderlik etmek, CANIAS ERP projelerinde analiz, planlama, test, kullanıcı kabul ve canlıya geçiş süreçlerini yönetmek, CANIAS ERP ile banka, e-ticaret, CRM, BI, bordro, e-fatura/e-arşiv ve diğer kurumsal uygulamalar arasındaki entegrasyon süreçlerini yönetmek, Veri kalitesi, veri güvenliği, yetkilendirme ve erişim kontrollerinin etkin şekilde uygulanmasını sağlamak, CANIAS ERP veri tabanı ve uygulama performansını takip etmek; gerekli iyileştirmeleri planlamak, Yönetim raporlaması ve dashboard ihtiyaçlarını analiz ederek ilgili çözümlerin geliştirilmesini sağlamak, Anahtar kullanıcı (key user) yapısını oluşturmak ve yönetmek, CANIAS ERP kullanıcı eğitimlerini planlamak, eğitim içeriklerini ve dokümantasyonunu hazırlamak, güncelleme, bakım ve versiyon geçişlerini planlamak ve yönetmek, CANIAS ERP hizmet sağlayıcıları ve dış kaynak ekipleriyle ilişkileri yönetmek, CANIAS ERP ile ilgili proje, bakım, lisans ve geliştirme bütçelerini takip etmek, Üst yönetime düzenli olarak proje ilerleme, sistem performansı, riskler ve iyileştirme fırsatları hakkında raporlama yapmak, Grup şirketleri arasında CANIAS ERP süreçlerinin mümkün olduğunca standardize edilmesine ve dijital dönüşüm hedeflerinin gerçekleştirilmesine liderlik etmek.
